definitions.full: H1380. Gebal גְּבַל proper name, of a location maritime city on the Phoenician coast Ezek 27:9 ; (Phoenician גבל = Byblus (Sm Di Josh 13:5 ); in Assyrian Gubli COT Gloss ); modern Jebeil Bd Pal 358 ; see also Furrer ZPV viii.20
